name: generate_video
description: Generate a video. Apps UI local file: call `media_upload_widget`; do not ask for Claude chat attachments; remote tools cannot read them. Web media URL: call `media_import_url`, pass returned `media_id`; `medias[].value` must be media_id/job_id, not URL. Defaults: `marketing_studio_video` for ads/product; `seedance_2_0` for identity, then `kling3_0` for multi-shot/audio/motion transfer, or `kling3_0_turbo` for fast text-to-video / single start-frame animation. URL Marketing Studio: call `show_marketing_studio(action='fetch')`, use returned `url`. Uploaded-image products: call `show_marketing_studio(type='product', medias[])`/`action='create'`, use `next_step`. Hooks/settings only for presets UGC, Tutorial, Unboxing, Product Review, UGC Virtual Try On; if ids missing, list hooks/settings first. Use declared roles: start_image/end_image/image. Pass generate_audio only if declared; Seedance audio via medias. Use models_explore for durations/params. Apply adjustments. If recovery_tool returned, call it immediately; do not explain/ask first. get_cost:true preflights credits.

model.description: Model ID from the model catalog (required).

prompt.description: Text description of what to generate. Optional for Marketing Studio workflows.

value.description: UUID from media_upload/media_import_url or job_id from a prior generation. Do not pass https:// URLs here.

role.description: Role — varies by model; inspect the selected model's medias[].roles. Server may auto-coerce when unambiguous.

get_cost.description: If true, return the cost in credits for this generation without submitting any job. Use to preflight cost before generating.

preset_id.description: Preset id from presets_show. Use only with model: higgsfield_preset.

declined_preset_id.description: Preset id declined by the user. Suppresses only that exact preset recommendation for this literal generation retry.

duration.description: Duration in seconds. Missing → model default. Unsupported → nearest allowed value or clamped to range.
